description_excerpt: Job Description • To take lead of the research and development of new services of factory audit and special projects • To self-learn & understand related local regulation • To gain & update technical knowledge on textile & footwear production processes • To provide technical consultation, recommendation/solutions to clients and team members • To arrange technical seminars and trainings to clients and team members whenever needed • To take lead and monitor the accreditation status following ISO17065 requirements • Keeps the team abreast of updated standards and regulations (if requested) •…
